name: BasedTools

sources.title: Homepage — live AI tools directory with 'Submit Product' in nav
Submit page — Free Track ($0, requires backlink + DR>15) and Premium Track ($9.99/mo)

conditions: Free Track requires embedding a follow link to https://www.basedtools.ai/ on your homepage (anchor 'Based Tools AI')
Tool's domain must have DR > 15 to qualify for the free track
Listing is removed if the reciprocal backlink is removed
requirements: Free track: DR > 15 and a reciprocal homepage backlink
Paid Premium Track ($9.99/mo, listed as 'most popular', claims DR 47) has no queue and skips the backlink requirement
Form fields: Tool Name, Website URL, Short Description (AI-generated if skipped), Description, and one document/image upload (max 10MB)
preparation: Short and long descriptions (optional — the site AI-generates missing copy)
For the free track: ability to add an HTML backlink snippet to the product homepage and evidence of DR > 15
workflow: Choose Free Track (add the backlink code first) or Premium Track ($9.99/mo)
Fill Tool Name, Website URL, descriptions, and upload an image/doc
Submit; free-track listings are reviewed within ~24 hours, premium goes live in seconds
watchFor: Free listing is contingent on keeping the reciprocal backlink live — removal delists the tool
DR > 15 floor means brand-new domains do not qualify for free
Heavy NSFW/adult category mix on the directory — consider brand adjacency before listing
Premium is a subscription; cancelling removes the listing
Descriptions left blank are AI-generated — supply your own copy to control positioning
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page on basedtools.ai and appears in its category listing
unknowns: Whether the free track checks the DR floor automatically or at manual review
Whether an account is required (a Sign In link exists but the submit form renders without auth)
